en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town built on a hillside, with orchards or gardens in the foreground. A row of traditional German houses, some half‑timbered, stretches across the middle, and on the right stands a large church with a distinctive tower and dome-like roof. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location, and smaller publisher information appears in the lower left corner.
